correctness.rationale: G=L(K5)=J(5,2) has 10 metric points, 30 edges, diameter 2, so the real 9-dimensional free unit ball is a symmetric edge polytope. At a polar vertex active ± incidence normals span dimension 9 iff tight-edge graph connected. Along a tight spanning tree differences are ±1 and normalization min f=0 gives integer f; graph diameter 2 gives f in {0,1,2}^10. Thus checking exactly 3^10=59049 candidate assignments is exhaustive, not sampling. Independently enumerated 1032 connected-tight admissible potentials, with tight edge-count multiplicities {12:110,14:300,16:330,18:280,20:12}, levels {2:922,3:110}. Independent S5×C2 orbit enumeration yielded 17 orbits of exactly stated sizes; the five maximum K4 stars distinguish S5 as all graph automorphisms. Every K4 star contributes at most 4 tight edges, so upper bound 20. Equality forces balanced 2+2 at all five K5 vertices; no simultaneous level 0/2 classes on 5 ground vertices; hence each color is spanning 2-regular, necessarily complementary Hamiltonian 5-cycles, 12 labeled maximizers. The equality proof does not depend solely on enumeration.
